item.title: Film Certification Gets Quicker In India - All About Reduced CBFC Timeline, Online System
item.description: India’s film certification process has become much faster with CBFC’s new online system. While the law allows up to 48 working days, films are now getting certified quicker. Feature films take about 18 days, and short films are cleared in just three days.

item.title: Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar Debuts With 7.8 Million Viewership On Netflix, Dethrones Ranbir Kapoor's Animal
item.description: Dhurandhar premiered on Netflix on January 30. After initial hiccups, the film went on to break records on the streaming platform. According to Netflix, Dhurandhar got a viewership of 7.8 million in the first weekend.

item.title: What is the 3-3-3 Weight Loss Method Going Viral? Here’s Why It Works
item.description: The 3-3-3 weight loss method is a simple, structured approach to sustainable fat loss that’s going viral online. Created by nutritionist Simrun Chopra, it focuses on three balanced meals, three food groups per meal, and three workouts weekly. Combined with walking, hydration, and sleep, it promotes steady weight loss without extreme dieting or calorie counting.
